definitions.gloss: monaka; wafer-shell sweet filled with bean paste
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection of sweet adzuki-bean paste sandwiched between two thin, crisp wafer shells made from glutinous rice.

examples.japanese: {最中|もなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

examples.english: This shop's monaka has a wonderfully crisp shell.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んだ→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧{最中|もなか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Ice-cream monaka, with ice cream packed into the wafer shells, is a summer staple.

notes:
A wagashi (Japanese sweet) made of ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ (bean paste) between two crisp rice-flour wafers. Modern versions may use ice cream or other fillings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧{最中|もなか}: ice-cream monaka
- {最中|もなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: the wafer shell of a monaka

USAGE:
The same characters are also read さいちゅう ({最中|さいちゅう}), meaning "in the middle of (doing something)" — a completely different word. The sweet is always もなか.
